name: cabane-monorepo
description: Kabane — local-first issue tracker and kanban for humans and AI agent runtimes

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run fmt:check
scripts.typecheck: for pkg in packages/*/; do (cd $pkg && bun run typecheck) || exit 1; done
scripts.test: bun test packages/core packages/sqlite packages/acp packages/cli packages/board && bun run --cwd packages/worker test
scripts.test:bun: bun test packages/core packages/sqlite packages/acp packages/cli packages/board
